content: Ersa Tujiladene Onxian Giezho
Ersa ene kielienyi kieliedene qiorunne qila asiman jiere uzhe kieliewo, "Ada, shihou kuruwo. Chi Kewone kuai, ingiese Kewonye chii kuaine.
Chi Kewondene ogisan kunlade chanqiku aminni ogine giezhi soyuji kunlai man gonjiku qienlii hhende ogizho.
Niekozi zhen Hudai tanizhi hhe peizhi ireghasan Ersa Mexihani tanise chanqiku amin enbene.
Chi made fenfulasan wiliei bi onchen giezhi ene zemin jierese chade kuaikui ireghawo.
Ada, ede chii melie made famani ogi. Duyase melie matan hhantu xianshou giesan famani made ogi."
"Chi duya jierese made ogisan kunlade bi chii nierei mejieghawo. Hhela benshenshi chinughun wo. Chi hhelai made ogiwo. Hhelaye chini kielienyi zunjiwo.
Ede hhela chi made ogisanshi man chii hhense iresanyi mejiewo.
Chi made ogisan kielienyi bi hhelade ogise hhela jienliewo. Hhela bishi chii hhense iresanyi mejiewo. Chi mini peizhi ireghasanyiye xianxin giewo."
"Bi hhelade oluzhi onxian giezho. Duyani kunlade oluzhi onxian ese giezho. Hhelashi chinughun wo. Ingiese chi made ogisan kunlade bi onxian giezho.
Minughunshi man chinughun wo. Chinughunshi minughun wo. Hhelai jierese made kuaikui irezho.
Enense khuinashi bi duyade uwo. Hhela duyade wine. Bi chii hhende echine. Zhiguitu Ada, chi made ogisan niereghalane hhelai baohu giezhi matan mutun hhelai niekozi gholugha.
Bi hhelare hhantu bikude chi made ogisan niereghalane bi hhelai baohu giezhi ezheliezho. Chugo hhe widaku kunse andase pse nieda ulie widane. Ene jinwun jieredu kielien mutun gholuwo."
"Ede bi chii hhende echine. Bi duyade bikudeni mii bayasukughala hhelai bayasughane giezhi enezighan kielienlai kieliewo.
Bi chii kielienyi hhelade ogidene duya hhelai henjiwo. Ene yenyinshi bi duyanughun pusho mutun hhelashiye duyanughun pusho.
Hhelai, 'Duyase khizhegha!' giezhi bi chii xiahua ulie giene, 'Hhe doghunnise baohu!' gie giezhi xiahua giene.
Bi duyanughun pusho mutun hhelaye duyanughun pusho.
Zhendaoghala zuise hhelai zhiguishigha. Chii kielienshijiu zhendao wo.
Chi mii duyade peizhi ireghasan mutun bi hhelaiye qingiezhi duyade peizhi echighane.
Bi hhelade oluzhi goyane zhiguishighawo. Ingiese hhelaiye zhendaoi tungo giezhi zhiguishighane."
"Bi zinie enelade oluzhi onxian gieku pusho. Hhelai kielienyi chenliedene mii xianxin giesan kunladeye onxian giezho.
Bi onxian giese Ada mii sudoro wo, bi chii sudoro biku mutun, hhelaye matanyi sudoro nie gholu gie. Ingiese duyai kunlai chi mii peizhi ireghasanyi xianxin giegha."
"Chi made ogisan famani bi hhelade ogiwo. Ingiese hhelai matan mutun nie gholughane.
Bi hhelai sudoro wo, Chi mii sudoro wo, hhelai man nie gholughane. Ingiese duyai kunlai chi mii peizhi ireghasanyi, pse chi made oresan mutun hhelade oresanyi mejieghane.
Ada, chi made ogisan hhela bi khalashi khala bizhi mii famani hhelade uzhegha. Ene mienzishi duyai zhayaghaku melie chi made orezhi ogisan wo."
"Gundantu Ada, duyai kunla chii tani dane. Bi chii tanine. Enezighan tujila chi mii peizhi ireghasanyi mejiene.
Bi hhelade chii mejieghawo, izhi mejieghane. Ingiese chi made oresan hhelai sudoro wo, biye hhelai sudoro wo."
